Japan UCC Coffee
Refined genuine coffee beans 100%.

Item Description:

1) Refined genuine coffee beans 100%.
2) Strong/Rich Aroma.
3) They selected from 500 blend samples, origins from Brazil and Columbia, and is roasted by traditional Japanese method.

5) Enjoy this rich blend at home or at work.

HOT SERVE:
1) Pour the sachet's contents into a cup.
2)Mix in 140 ml of hot water stir and enjoy.

COLD SERVE:

It is an instant coffee that has been loved for a long time since the birth of 1988.
He stick to the blend so that you can feel the acidity, bitterness and aftertaste in a balanced way.

UCC instant coffee can be found in almost every home in Japan, enjoy this rich blend at home or at work, just add hot water.
